What comes first—the energy transition or the materials to enable it? Energy accounts for 20-40% of OPEX in mineral processing. Maximize flotation system recovery Around 15% of precious metals mined find their way to the tailings pond. Don’t let the complexity of your float system increase that number. Imubit AI models learn the nonlinear relationships between process variables like reagent concentration, bubble formation, and rotor speed, then tune the available handles to maximize recovery of every float tank under every process condition. Imubit models make the most of your energy input, pushing to the max power draw limit, maximizing throughput and minimizing reagent usage in flotation through consistent and optimal control of particle size distribution. In steel production, raw material variability and delayed lab-measured properties add complexity. Imubit AI models learn the complex, nonlinear composition relationships and put them into closed loop to reduce rework and energy costs and provide more consistent mechanical properties. Sustainability Company  Menu Overview Leadership Careers Contact Partners Resources Resources Blog Get Assessment Get Assessment PARTNERS & ALLIANCES Imubit’s Partner and Alliance Ecosystem Our partner ecosystem delivers proven and integrated AI solutions that transform process industries worldwide . Become a Partner View Our Partners Imubit provides a platform for Industrial Coordinated Operating Strategies, enabling people, processes, and systems to operate in alignment around shared objectives , constraints, and outcomes, taking existing control, planning, or execution systems to the next level of value. Our cloud environment enables advanced AI model development, training, and dynamic scenario simulation, giving operators powerful decision-support and optimization insights. When it comes to execution, those models are securely deployed on-premises within the plant’s OT network, where they operate in closed-loop, continuously optimizing and adjusting process controls in real time while meeting strict industrial safety and reliability requirements. Together, these capabilities form an AI platform for Industrial Coordinated Operating Strategies, enabling people, processes, and systems to execute strategy in a coordinated way , without replacing existing control, planning, or execution systems. Partner Categories Strategic Technology & Integration Alliances We collaborate with software vendors and automation platforms to build interoperable solutions. These integrations ensure customers can seamlessly adopt AI within their existing DCS, MES, APC, and historian environments — bridging the gap between AI (optimization) and operations. Channel & Service Delivery Partners Our channel and service delivery partners bring the operational depth and customer intimacy required for large-scale deployments. They extend Imubit’s reach, delivering domain expertise, localized insight, and world-class service across global markets. Together, we help customers not just optimize with AI — but transform how their operations run. Partners Our partners represent a diverse ecosystem of technology innovators, service providers, and regional experts driving meaningful change across process industries worldwide. Why Partner with Imubit From AI Intelligence to Coordinated Execution Imubit embeds intelligence inside operating plants to optimize and control in real time. As customers embrace AI, our partners are at the forefront of coordinated autonomous operations — expanding portfolios, opening new service lines, and scaling multi-site programs that compound value over time. We partner with organizations that see AI not as a tool for local optimization, but as a platform for coordinated strategy execution across people, processes, and systems, reshaping how plants run, day to day and at scale. Our solution isn’t a concept or a pilot — it’s a proven technology that lives across more than 100 closed-loop applications , backed by over ten patents and trusted by several of the world’s leading process manufacturers. We’re looking for trailblazers who share our vision and want to build the future of industrial operations alongside us. Deliver True Transformation While isolated pilots can build confidence, they rarely deliver scale . Imubit partners with organizations committed to true digital transformation, not technology for its own sake. Imubit enables partners to help customers move from reactive, fragmented decision-making to operationalized and increasingly automated execution of coordinated operating strategies. This means rethinking ROI frameworks, collaboration models, and operating practices to realize full enterprise value . Joint Innovation & Integration Our modular, open architecture enables partners to co-create integrations and embed intelligence alongside existing systems — DCS, MES, APC, and historian. We collaborate with leading technology and automation providers and are continuously expanding our ecosystem of supported platforms. Global Scale, Local Depth Our channel partners amplify Imubit’s reach, enabling deployment at scale while embedding local domain expertise , customer relationships, and service excellence. They speak our customers’ language, understand their business priorities , and tailor Imubit’s AIO solution to fit local operational realities. Investment in Partnership Success Partners are a core pillar of Imubit’s strategy and growth. We invest in joint go-to-market initiatives , enablement, certification, and technical support to ensure our partners are equipped for success. Our focus is on building a small number of deep partnerships capable of supporting repeatable, multi-site execution as customers advance their coordinated strategy maturity. Our philosophy is simple: we win when you win. Become an Imubit Partner Ready to help transform the future of process manufacturing? If you build technology, integrate systems, or deliver field expertise, we want to work with you. Connect with us to explore partnership opportunities and unlock new growth for your customers and your business. Sustainability Company  Menu Overview Leadership Careers Contact Partners Resources Resources Blog Get Assessment Get Assessment Data Security Policy Imubit keeps your data secure and confidential, so you can trust its integrity, and it is available upon your request. We do it by complying with the highest security standards, and continuous monitoring and improving our Information Security Management System (ISMS). Last modified: April 18, 2023 1. Security Imubit keeps your data secure and confidential, so you can trust its integrity, and it is available upon your request. We do it by complying with the highest security standards, and continuous monitoring and improving our Information Security Management System (ISMS). 2. Confidentiality We know that the security of your business and information is one of your top priorities. Imubit implements state-of-the-art security measures in order to secure our customers’ environment. Imubit runs on AWS and GCP infrastructure and relies on their strengthened data center security. We keep all our systems always updated in order to block any attempt to take advantage of known vulnerabilities. Imubit implements security measures on top of those provided by AWS and GCP in order to assure that its security complies with the highest standards in the market. Imubit runs continuous penetration tests in order to test its security and resilience to cyber attacks on our cloud environments. End-to-end encryption: Imubit encrypts all data both at rest and in motion so no unauthorized 3rd party can be exposed to the data of our services. 3. Availability and Integrity Imubit is running from multiple zones and regions in order to provide continuous service with minimum downtime. Imubit’s data is continuously backed up in order to allow fast and full recovery in case of data erasure or alternation. Imubit tests the effectiveness of its backups and restore procedures on a regular basis in order to test the effectiveness of those measures and to be prepared for any scenario. Imubit’s SLA policy is available upon request 4. Compliance Imubit has completed a SOC2 Type2 audit for the period of March 1st 2022 to February 28th 2023. Imubit has completed a GDPR readiness assessment. The full report is available upon request and signing of an NDA. 5. Standards and Policies Imubit employs strict security standards and measures throughout the entire organization. All employees and contractors complete the Imubit security awareness and data handling training programs at least annually. All visitors to Imubit offices are registered as such or accompanied by an Imubit employee. Imubit has an extensive employee policy to protect all parties against exposure or damage. Processes are set in place to ensure that all employee devices comply with the security policy. If you have any questions, concerns, complaints or suggestions regarding our Data Security Policy or otherwise need to contact us, you may contact us at the contact information below or through the “Contact Imubit” page on our Website. (" Greenhouse ") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting it in accordance with applicable laws and using generally-accepted industry practices. This Privacy Policy explains who we are, how we collect, share, and use personal information about you, and how you can exercise your privacy rights. For purposes of this Privacy Policy, “ Personal Information ” means any information that is available to Greenhouse and that is protected explicitly by the European Union General Data Protection Regulation of 2016 (the “ EU GDPR ”); the EU GDPR as saved into United Kingdom law by virtue of section 3 of the United Kingdom’s European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 (the " UK GDPR "); and the California Consumer Protection Act (“ CCPA ”), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020, to the extent applicable. If you have any questions or concerns about Greenhouse’s collection and use of your Personal Information, please contact us using the contact details provided below. If however, your questions or concerns are related to a Greenhouse customer’s collection and use of your Personal Information, please contact that customer directly. This Privacy Policy does not apply to the Personal Information collected and used by Greenhouse customers, such as when you apply to a job via a Greenhouse-hosted job board. Please note that Greenhouse is not a data broker, does not sell or share personal data of job candidates or individuals with whom it does not have a direct relationship, and is not subject to data broker laws or registries. Scope of this policy Greenhouse is a leading provider of cloud-based software services that help companies manage and optimize their recruiting and hiring processes. Greenhouse processes personal data in the following contexts: 1. As a processor on behalf of its customers for recruiting and onboarding purposes. This Privacy Policy does not apply to Personal Information in this context. Our customers are the controllers of the Personal Information they collect through Greenhouse’s Services to manage their own recruiting and onboarding processes ( e.g. , names, contact information, and other data collected as part of job applications), and each customer manages that Personal Information in accordance with its own privacy policies. Greenhouse’s privacy commitments to our customers are governed by a separate customer agreement that authorizes us to collect, process, and store Personal Information on their behalf, as a processor under the EU GDPR and the UK GDPR, and a service provider under the CCPA. Greenhouse processes Personal Information relating to our customers’ employees and job applicants within our Services only according to our customers’ instructions (as defined in our customer agreements), and we have no direct relationship with the individuals whose Personal Information we process in connection with our customers’ use of our Services. For example, if you apply to a job posted on a career page of a Greenhouse customer, your Personal Information will be automatically processed by Greenhouse on behalf of that customer. However, the company you applied to is the data controller (or business, as that term is defined in the CCPA) with respect to your Personal Information, and you should contact that entity directly with any questions you may have regarding its privacy policies or data processing practices, or if you wish to modify or access your Personal Information, restrict its processing, or delete it. Greenhouse’s customer contracts require us to redirect inquiries relating to the Personal Information we process on behalf of a customer back to that customer without taking any action on the request. 2. As a controller in a commercial/B2B context ( e.g. , managing business relationships with customers and vendors). 3. As a controller in an employment context ( e.g. , processing job applications for Greenhouse’s own hiring). 4. As a controller for the MyGreenhouse service, where Personal Information is collected directly from individuals who choose to create MyGreenhouse accounts manage their job search.
